transcript:
Speaker A (Husband): कविता, बॉस आने वाले हैं। तो प्लीज तुम किचन से बाहर मत आना। [Kavita, boss is about to arrive. So please don't come out of the kitchen.]
Speaker B (Wife): ठीक है। [Okay.]
Speaker A: Welcome sir. Sir, how was the journey?
Speaker C (Boss): It was great Sunil. By the way, you have a nice home. Well done.
Speaker A: Thank you, sir.
Speaker B: Sir, have some water. What would you like, tea or coffee?
Speaker C: Coffee, please.
Speaker A: कविता, तुम तो छा गई आज! इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश? मुझे कभी नहीं बताया? [Kavita, you nailed it today! Such good English? You never told me?]
Speaker B: आपको क्या लगता है? वाईफाई सिर्फ सीरियल देखने के लिए लगवाया है? इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप। रोज 30 मिनट। जब आप ऑफिस जाते थे, तब मैं एआई कोच के साथ प्रैक्टिस करती थी। गलत बोलती थी, सुधार देती थी। कभी जज नहीं किया, आपकी तरह। तीन महीने से प्रैक्टिस कर रही हूं। [What do you think? Is the Wi-Fi only for watching serials? English Seekho app. 30 minutes daily. When you went to the office, I used to practice with the AI coach. If I spoke incorrectly, it corrected me. It never judged, unlike you. I've been practicing for three months.]
Speaker A: अब तुम्हें किचन में रहने की जरूरत नहीं है। चलो, बॉस के साथ कॉफी पीते हैं। [Now you don't need to stay in the kitchen. Come, let's have coffee with the boss.]
Speaker B: उसने बोला था ना कि किचन से बाहर मत निकलना। आज खुद बोला कि चलो बाहर चलो। अगर आपको भी किचन से बाहर रहना है, इज्जत पानी है, तो ₹1 का ट्रायल आज। [He said not to come out of the kitchen, right? Today he himself said let's go outside. If you also want to stay out of the kitchen and earn respect, get the 1 rupee trial today.]
Speaker D (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: A husband tells his wife to stay in the kitchen when his boss visits due to her poor English. She surprises them by speaking fluent English, explaining she practiced daily with the English Seekho AI coach. She invites viewers to gain respect and try the app for 1 rupee.
